mapper.select: /* [신청관리 > OCR신청조회] 조건 진행상태 - selectProcStatList */ SELECT CD_GROUP AS cdGrpId, CD_VAL AS cd, CD_NM AS cdNm FROM ocuoc_ccdtl_l WHERE 1=1 AND CD_GROUP = 'PRGS_ST_CD' AND UZ_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY LNUP_SER ASC

if.test: keyword != null and keyword != '' and keywordType == 'FORM_NM'
keyword != null and keyword != '' and keywordType == 'APPLICANT'
onlyMine and loginUserId != null and loginUserId != ''

mapper.select:
/* [신청관리 > OCR신청조회] OCR서식신청 조회 - selectFormApplList */ SELECT A.APPC_ID AS no, A.PRGS_ST_CD AS procStatCd, C.CD_NM AS procStatNm, A.LEFRM_NM AS formNm, U.EMP_KOR_FLNM AS applicantNm, D.BR_NM AS applDeptNm, A.REG_DT AS applDate, A.CHNG_DT AS updateDate FROM ocuoc_lfapp_m A LEFT JOIN ocuoc_ccdtl_l C ON C.CD_GROUP = 'PRGS_ST_CD' AND C.CD_VAL = A.PRGS_ST_CD LEFT JOIN ocuoc_useri_m U ON U.EMPNO = A.APCT_ID LEFT JOIN ocuoc_dprmi_m D ON D.BR_CD = U.BLNG_BRCD
ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC, A.APPC_ID DESC

/* [신청관리 > OCR신청조회] 페이징 - selectFormApplCount */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocuoc_lfapp_m A LEFT JOIN ocuoc_ccdtl_l C ON C.CD_GROUP = 'PRGS_ST_CD' AND C.CD_VAL = A.PRGS_ST_CD LEFT JOIN ocuoc_useri_m U ON U.EMPNO = A.APCT_ID LEFT JOIN ocuoc_dprmi_m D ON D.BR_CD = U.BLNG_BRCD

/* [신청관리 > OCR신청조회] 엑셀다운 - selectFormApplListAll */ SELECT A.APPC_ID AS no, A.PRGS_ST_CD AS procStatCd, C.CD_NM AS procStatNm, A.LEFRM_NM AS formNm, U.EMP_KOR_FLNM AS applicantNm, D.BR_NM AS applDeptNm, A.REG_DT AS applDate, A.CHNG_DT AS updateDate FROM ocuoc_lfapp_m A LEFT JOIN ocuoc_ccdtl_l C ON C.CD_GROUP = 'PRGS_ST_CD' AND C.CD_VAL = A.PRGS_ST_CD LEFT JOIN ocuoc_useri_m U ON U.EMPNO = A.APCT_ID LEFT JOIN ocuoc_dprmi_m D ON D.BR_CD = U.BLNG_BRCD
ORDER BY A.REG_DT DESC, A.APPC_ID DESC
